title: 第11章 你看我像你老公不？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    方芸连头都没回，毫不在意地微微点头，手指继续在操作台上划动。

    幽蓝色的水晶台面上，两张虚幻的图纸瞬间被点亮。

    【简易壁炉】

    消耗：1石材，1木材。体力：8点。耗时：1分钟。

    【简易工作台】

    消耗：5木材，5石材。体力：8点。耗时：1小时。

    方芸从储物空间里拽出几根枯枝，随手扔进刚成型的简易壁炉火塘里。

    噗嗤。

    根本不需要引火物，接触到底部的瞬间，火苗自动窜起，瞬间将阴冷驱散。

    温度有了，光亮有了。

    现在，只剩下水和食物没有着落。

    许默靠着墙，缓缓闭上眼睛。

    意识深处，他试图通过精神控制蜂后。

    太远了。

    那只被驯服的变异蜂后，此刻正翻山越岭，疯狂赶来，但距离这里还是超过十公里。

    指望不上。

    许默立刻切断联系，精神感知开启，顺着庇护所周围潮湿的岩缝疯狂蔓延。

    既然蜂后能被驱使，那满地爬行的其他昆虫呢？

    窸窸窣窣——

    极其细微的刮擦声从四面八方的石缝里传出。

    方芸猛地握紧石斧，眼神戒备地扫向四周。

    一滩令人头皮发麻的黑潮，正从墙角的裂缝中沸腾狂涌而出！

    那是成百上千只体型硕大的变异黑蚁！

    它们层层叠叠地堆积在一起，节肢碰撞，发出令人牙酸的声响。

    “去探路。”

    许默在心底猛地下达指令。

    轰的一下，那滩黑潮瞬间炸开，化作无数条黑线，悄无声息地四散融入洞穴外茫茫的丛林之中。

    方芸收回警惕的目光，深深看了许默一眼。

    但她没说话，没发问。

    转身一把掀开角落的储物箱。

    几件散发着微光的物品躺在其中。

    【坚固的石斧】（白色，1阶，耐久50/50）

    【坚固的石镐】（白色，1阶，耐久50/50）

    【面包果*3】（保质期7天，单颗可满足成年人单日所需饱腹感）
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Fang Yun didn’t even turn her head, nodded slightly indifferently, and continued to move her fingers on the console.

On the blue crystal table, two illusory drawings were instantly lit up.

【Simple fireplace】

Consumption: 1 stone, 1 wood.Physical strength: 8 points.Time taken: 1 minute.

【Simple workbench】

Consumption: 5 wood, 5 stone.Physical strength: 8 points.Time taken: 1 hour.

Fang Yun pulled out a few dead branches from the storage space and threw them into the newly formed simple fireplace.



There is no need for fire starters at all. The moment it touches the bottom, the flames will automatically jump out, instantly dissipating the coldness.

The temperature is there and the light is there.

Now, only water and food are left.

Xu Mo leaned against the wall and slowly closed his eyes.

Deep in his consciousness, he tried to control the queen bee through his mind.

It’s too far.

The tamed mutated queen bee is now rushing over the mountains and ridges, but it is still more than ten kilometers away from here.

Can’t count on it.

Xu Mo immediately cut off contact, and his spiritual perception opened, spreading crazily along the damp rock crevices around the shelter.

Since the queen bee can be driven, what about the other insects crawling all over the ground?

Rustling rustling——

Extremely subtle scratching sounds came from the cracks in the rocks in all directions.

Fang Yun clenched the stone ax fiercely and glanced around with wary eyes.

A pool of scalp-numbing black tide is boiling and gushing out from the cracks in the corner of the wall!

Those are hundreds or thousands of huge mutated black ants!

They are piled up layer upon layer, and their joints and limbs collide, making a tooth-staining sound.

"Go explore the road."

Xu Mo gave instructions fiercely in his heart.

With a bang, the black tide exploded instantly and turned into countless black lines, quietly scattering into the vast jungle outside the cave.

Fang Yun withdrew her vigilant gaze and took a deep look at Xu Mo.

But she didn’t speak or ask any questions.

Turn around and open the storage box in the corner.

Several shimmering items lay among them.

【Sturdy Stone Ax】(white, level 1, durability 50/50)

【Sturdy Stone Pickaxe】(white, level 1, durability 50/50)

【Breadfruit*3】(Shelf life is 7 days, one piece can satisfy the satiety required by adults for a single day)
